entries.reason: AI Tools in Settings: the row and the AI Tools page read defaultProvider from GET /ai-tools/status (the default model and which accounts count as logged in); an older server sends none, so the row cannot say which provider chats run on.

provider failure cards in chats: their Switch, Continue and Retry buttons call POST /ai-tools/provider-failures/:messageId/switch and /continue; an older server has no such routes and writes no provider_failure or provider_outage parts.

default switching: the pinned-chat hint reads followsDefault and pinnedModel on GET /chat/sessions/:id and calls POST /chat/sessions/:id/model/follow-default; the logout dialogs send moveExisting to the logout routes; account cards offer Retry and a switch reads refreshed. An older server sends none of the fields, ignores moveExisting and refuses Retry on an account card.
